repair_cycles.root_cause: The profile model did not expose the exact v2 visual-source authority and closed route taxonomy.
repair_cycles.repair: Added typed exact literals, 13 routes, NativeFFmpegRenderer authority, native exact-content rules, 1080p block, human approval, and archive verification.

repair_cycles.root_cause: VSR1, IMG1, VQC1, canary, and Drive evidence could be copied or weakly referenced.
repair_cycles.repair: Compiler now validates and hash-binds the existing qualified refs without duplicating their payloads.

repair_cycles.root_cause: A generic approval ref or unbounded semantic diff could authorize unrelated v2 changes.
repair_cycles.repair: Required the exact master approval ref and an allowlist plus required-set check for the approved v2 diff paths.

repair_cycles.root_cause: An initial 0.75 threshold would have added an unapproved profile diff.
repair_cycles.repair: Removed the invented profile field and deterministically reused the approved Pexels semantic-fit threshold 0.78 with ref/version/hash derivation evidence.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Digest compilation initially read visual-source profile data from the wrong compiled payload level.
repair_cycles.repair: Resolved the value from channel_scoped_policy.visual_source_policy_binding while preserving the compiled snapshot as authority.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Hash shape alone could not prove that caller-provided semantic digest content came from authoritative objects.
repair_cycles.repair: M5 and D2P1 now recompile the digest and compare exact semantic content, nested AgentContextPack content, runtime guard, refs, and pack hash.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Strict context callers could attempt to replace authority, digest, or policy fields.
repair_cycles.repair: Reserved fields are compiler-owned and caller overrides fail closed before prompt routing.

repair_cycles.root_cause: A single generic word could make an adjacent-niche topic appear relevant.
repair_cycles.repair: Required criterion-level evidence, two scope tokens, and a distinctive non-generic anchor with deterministic plural normalization.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Optional runtime values could attempt to force policy PASS or loosen the compiled cost cap.
repair_cycles.repair: Policy fit is derived from typed gates and score evidence; the cost firewall always uses the frozen compiled cap.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Daily generation had an obsolete hard block and could not prove a persisted router run on success.
repair_cycles.repair: Wired DailyIdeaAgent through Prompt Registry and LLMRouter, required LLMRunSnapshot, and propagated unconfigured/failed routes closed.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Admission evidence did not fully bind the DailyIdeaDecision subject hash, digest, snapshot, typed gate, and channel-fit dossier.
repair_cycles.repair: Unified the M5/D2P1 subject-hash contract and made all pre-admission bindings exact and content-hashed.

repair_cycles.root_cause: A package could lack typed thumbnail or other downstream niche evidence.
repair_cycles.repair: Registered all five gates, enforced Topic to Script to Visual to Thumbnail to Metadata ordering, and required a complete production dossier.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Requiring an already-ADMITTED DailyIdeaDecision prevented D2P1 from owning the existing M5 admission step.
repair_cycles.repair: Accepted an admissible immutable PROPOSED decision, created/reused the M5 ADMIT receipt, and rejected caller topic overrides.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Resolving the newest preflight could replace the preflight frozen by an existing admission.
repair_cycles.repair: Historical resume resolves the exact admission preflight; initial admission deterministically uses the earliest eligible preflight.

repair_cycles.root_cause: Read-only status without a receipt could report an unvalidated entry after storage drift.
repair_cycles.repair: Status now recomputes entry lineage read-only and exposes the earliest terminal admission without creating rows.

repair_cycles.root_cause: A failed Effective Context compile could leave a candidate project or initial artifacts behind.
repair_cycles.repair: Candidate project, Effective Context, and initial artifacts now share a nested transaction; failure rolls back the candidate and persists one idempotent BLOCK receipt.

repair_cycles.root_cause: The D2P1 fixture hid incomplete Channel Contract data behind a hand-built digest fallback.
repair_cycles.repair: Removed the fallback and supplied a COMPLETE authoritative contract so every D2P1 test uses the real digest compiler.

repair_cycles.root_cause: D2P1 compared gate evidence with an optional scoped value instead of the compiled top-level authority.
repair_cycles.repair: D2P1 now uses channel_fit_threshold_from_compiled_policy and fails closed when authority is missing.

repair_cycles.root_cause: M5 attempted PROPOSED-to-ADMITTED mutation on an immutable row, while digest recompile incorrectly required a formerly active frozen snapshot to remain current.
repair_cycles.repair: Kept DailyIdeaDecision immutable, made ProjectAdmissionDecision the transition authority, and added a narrow approved-historical recompile mode reachable only after an ADMIT project exists.

repair_cycles.root_cause: REVIEW_REQUIRED agent output was incorrectly returned as schema-validation failure, breaking nine M12.1 compatibility tests.
repair_cycles.repair: Restored validator status OK for valid repaired schema and made M5 inspect the normalized agent verdict to propagate REVIEW_REQUIRED or BLOCK closed.

exact_next_action: Wait for a separate operator-started LPRO1 task; keep PKG1 revision and MR1 execution on hold.
